commits.body:
- Create packages/mcp-server as a proper npm package
- Add bin field for npx execution
- Add GitHub Action for npm publishing on release tags
- Update plugin .mcp.json to use npx -y 247-mcp-server
- Remove old mcp-server from plugin-247

This allows the MCP server to be installed via npx, solving
the dependency issue when installing the plugin.
